missing_evidence: Postgres server-side connection/pool metrics for the order service
Order service pool configuration and max connection settings
candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion at the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable after ~2s, causing order POST 503, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502 on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side metrics or pool config evidence; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s align with ~2s ReadTimeouts to the order service; traces show postgres save_order failing with pool size 5 and 0 idle, propagating 503 then 502. Deployment record shows only baseline v1.0.0 and does not establish causation.
